scope: Scorebug-only display layer: the on-air shade of each NFL team's sourced wing colour. team_colors_official_2026.json is unchanged; team_accents.json records, per team, the class, whether the shade was measured or fitted, its official parent and the sourced accent it replaces.

transfer.form: HSV hue kept, value 1, saturation times the factor; a chromatic result lighter than lightness_cap (OKLab L) is scaled down in linear light to the cap; measured shades must lie within measured_bound (OKLab distance) of their parent's fitted shade
